description: Aider-polyglot style (Kotlin, hard): write a recursive-descent parser for a simplified game-record format with properties, multi-valued keys, backslash escapes, node chains and nested variations, returning a tree of property maps. The tricky parts are that a chain makes each node the only child of the previous one while variations attach to the last node of the chain, that structure characters inside values are plain text, and a long list of malformed inputs that must throw. A plain Kotlin test runner compiled by run_tests.py is the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs it for a repair round.
